top_signals.title: Iraq's October Oil Exports Top 3.4 Million Bpd, Nearing Pre-War Levels
top_signals.summary: Iraq's oil exports have averaged more than 3.4 million barrels per day so far in October, Oil Minister Bassem Mohammed Khudair told the state news agency INA on Monday. That puts them close to the 3.3-3.5 million bpd Iraq shipped before the war with Iran choked traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. The October figure is a jump of about 750,000 bpd from September, when exports averaged 2.65 million bpd according to the oil ministry. Of that, 250,000 bpd moved through the Iraq-Turkey pipeline to Ceyhan. Khudair said Iraq is now exporting through…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The Copper Rally Faces a Tariff Test
top_signals.summary: Copper has surged amid tariff fears, but the rally may be vulnerable if U.S. trade measures don't materialize. Invesco's Kathy Kriskey joins Blooomberg Open Interest to explain how stockpiling, tariff uncertainty, and growing demand from data centers and electrification could shape what happens next. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ivanhoe Electric (IE) in Talks to Sell Arizona Copper Amid Data Center Demand
top_signals.summary: Ivanhoe Electric Inc. is in discussions with prospective buyers of copper from its project in Arizona, as the rapid expansion of data centers and power grids stokes demand for the metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Mercados dudan de la euforia electoral en Latinoamérica
top_signals.summary: Los fuertes rallies desatados por elecciones en Latinoamérica comienzan a mostrar grietas, mientras inversionistas evalúan si seguir apostando por la región o asegurar ganancias.

top_signals.title: CIBC Preps Up to C$1 Billion Limited Recourse Capital Note Sale
top_signals.summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce is readying a sale of as much as C$1 billion ($710 million) of additional tier-one bonds, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: High Frequency Trader Optiver Seeks $900 Million Debt Package
top_signals.summary: Optiver Holding BV is looking to secure about $900 million in financing as the market maker seeks to expand its trading activities, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: SkyAI sells off entire Solana treasury as it launches $201 million buyback
top_signals.summary: SkyAI holds $223.8 million in cash after selling all its SOL, with its $3 buyback running through Oct. 29.
